༄༅/ /gnod sbyin dmar nag gi skong gso dgra las rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnod sbyin dmar nag gi skong gso dgra las

rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs so/ / hūm̐ 'grub par gyur cig yon tan rdzogs pa'i lha/ /zil gnon pad+ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin dmar nag bsten pa'i gang zag gis/ /skong gso'i cho ga ji ltar bya ba bshad/ /de la gnod sbyin gyi bshos bu rtse rgyal la/ bshos bu zur gsum bzhi dang te la kha bzhis phyogs mtshams bskor ba'i mtshams su mthe bskyu dang nya bos brgyan/ dbus ma'i rtser dgra yi nya bo bting*/ yugs sa'i gzugs sha khrag gis bris pa bshams la/ bdag nyid pad+ma'i nga rgyal gyis mtshams bcad pa 'di skad do/ /hūm̐/ bskal pa'i me 'od klong dky-il na/ /thod mkhar rin chen 'bar bas brgyan/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs/ /de dbus nyi zla pad+ma'i steng*/ /rang nyid zil gnon khro bo'i sku/ /che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dbus nag po/ /smug nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ /zhal gdang mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad/ /dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes/ /sbrul dang thod skam 'bar bar brjid/ /phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po gnyis/ /rdo rje thod dbyug gdengs pa ste/ /tha ma'i g.yas na lcags sgrog dang*/ /g.yon na rgyu zhags 'debs pa'i tshul/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'dor stabs la/ / dpal gyi chas brgyad rngams pas brjid/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi 'phro 'du las/ / sprul ba'i khro chung glog ltar 'khyugs/ khro bo'i gsung sgra 'brug stong sgrogs/ / yang sprul grangs med sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /phyag mtshan mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs/ /bskal ba'i me ri 'du 'phro 'bar/ /stong khams thams cad khro bo'i zhing*/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phred rtsal hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyon gcig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ /nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed/ /dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /ci ste 'gro bar mi byed pa/ /stobs chen khro bo 'bar ba yis/

/mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*/ /lus kyang dum bu stong du gtubs/ /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+na gṛh+na hūṃ/ gṛh+na pa ya gṛh+na pa ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wā na bid+ya rā dza ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces brjod pas bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po thams cad rgya mtsho'i mthar byer bar bsam mo/ /de nas mdun du gnod sbyin 'khor bcas gsal bar byed pa'am/ /yod par mos pa tsam byas la/ /spos dang tshil chen gyi dud pa dang*/ /rol mos byin dbab cing snyan gsan drangs pa ni 'di skad do/ /e he rma ru tse bh+yo sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bh+yoḥ gling bzhi srid pa'i pho brang nas/ / phung byed dmar nag gshegs su gsol/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru/ / bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /gnod sbyin chen po gshegs su gsol/ /mthu rtsal ri rab thal bar rlog /rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /skad cig stong gsum rtsis la 'debs/ /srid gsum gsal zhing glog ltar 'gyu/ /thod mkhar rin chen 'bar ba 'dir/ /gnod spyin chen po da tshur byon/ /e bh+yo/ /dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /gnod sbyin chen po tshur gshegs shig /dmar mo mi zan tshur= /dam nyams bshan pa= /gza' 'dud chen po= gter bdag chen po= /rnal 'byor dgra lha= kyai/ gling bzhi'i ri rab rtse mo nas/ /gnod sbyin chen po drag rtsal can/ /chibs su khyung dmar rlung gshog bcibs/ /sku la dar dmar 'jol ber gsol/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig shub g.yon/ /rgyab tu bse yi phub dmar khur/ /phyag g.yas dar mdung dgra la 'debs/ /g.yon pas dgra snying rgyu zhags 'dzin/ / bse zhwa bse khrab si li li/ /dmag dpon chen po spyan 'dren no/ khyod kyi bka' nyan 'khor brgyad ni/ /shar phyogs rgyal po stag mgo can/ /chibs su rta dkar ze dmar bcibs/ /dar dkar ber chen zhub chas brgyan/ /stag ral g.yas la gzig shub g.yon/ /g.yas pas mdung dkar gnam la 'phyar/ /g.yon pas snying dang rgyu zhags 'dzin/

/rgyal po chen po spyan 'dren no/ /lho phyogs gshin rje gzig mgo can/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /chibs su rta dmar zhur po bcibs/ /dar dmar 'jol ber zhub chas brgyan/ stag ral= phyag g.yas mdung dmar= g.yon pas snying dang = /gshin rje chen po= /nub phyogs btsan rje dam mgo can/ / sku mdog sngon po 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /chibs su rta sngon glo dkar= dar sngon ber chen= stag ral= phyag g.yas= phyag g.yon snying dang = btsan rje chen po spyan=/ /byang phyogs bdud nag 'brong mgo can/ /sku mdog nag po 'jigasapa'i tshul/ /chibs su rta nag rting dkar= dar nag= stag ral= phyag g.yas mdung nag= g.yon pas snying dang = bdud nag chen po spyan= shar lho srin po ne tso'i mgo /sku mdog dud kha= chibs su sprin rta kham pa bcibs/ /dar ser stag ral= /phyag g.yas mdung nag= /g.yon pas snying dang = /srin po chen po spyan= /lho nub lha min rma bya'i mgo /sku mdog ljang nag= /sku la dar ber khro bo gsol/ /chibs su dril rta kha dkar= /phyag g.yas mdung nag= /g.yon pas snying dang = /lha min chen po spyan= /nub byang gza' bdud shang shang mgo/ /sku mdog dud kha= /chibs su rta nag zhur po= /dar nag 'jol ber zhub chas brgyan/ /stag ral/ /phyag g.yas mdung nag /g.yon pas snying dang*/ /byang shar klu bdud ser mig mgo / sku mdog mthing nag= /chibs su bra bo sngo nag= /dar ser mthing ga'i 'jol ber gsol/ /stag ral=/ /phyag g.yas mdung sngon= /g.yon pas snying dang = /klu bdud chen po= /de dag kun gyi bka' nyan pa/ /sprul pa gnod sbyin 'bum gyis bskor/ /yang sprul bye ba bsam mi khyab/ /'khor bcas ma lus spyan 'dren no/ /lha srin sde brgyad gnod sbyin tshogs/ /don la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang*/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung slad du/ / 'khor bcas ma lus spyan 'dren no/ /e he rma ru tse sa ma ya dza dzaḥ chu gtsang sman spos 'o rgyun gyis/

/phyag dang zhabs gnyis bsil mdzod la/ /dur khrod rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad cing*/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa/ / gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /dad pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /e he rma ru tse pu ru dza hoḥ zhes dgyes par gyur pa la/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ gis gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag las grub pa/ ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa/ rak+ta dang phyi nang mchod pa mang por dmigs la 'di skad do/ /e he rma ru tse sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra khā hi/ gnod sbyin chen po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtsho dang*/ /dam nyams bsgral ba'i gtor ma dmar chen 'bul/ /thugs dam gnyen bskang bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /gling bzhi ri rab 'dod yon sna tshogs dang*/ / gzugs sgra dri ro reg dang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rtsi thog sman sna shing thog 'bru bcud sogs/ /spyan gzigs zhal zas bdud rtsi ro brgyas mchod/ / dam nyams dgra bo bsgral ba yi/ /sha chen rak+ta la sogs pa/ /sha sna khrag sna 'bum gyis mchod/ /gsol zhig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ /bhan+dha rus pa'i tshil chen dang*/ /rtsi sman 'bru bcud chang gis mchod/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i ba liṃ 'di/ /gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /sman sna stong dang sha sna stong*/ khrag sna stong dang dza gad phud/ /chu sna stong dang snying sna 'bum/ /gnod sbyin= go ro tsa na ba su ta/ /dgra bo'i bla tshe srog dang dbugs/ /don snying nang rol dbang po lnga//gnod sbyin 'khor= /'bru sna rin chen dar zab lnga/ /gnod sbyin= gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bla bre 'phan/ /nam mkha' dar gyi mchod pa kun//gnod sbyin= /seng ge rta dang glang chen khyung*/ /gzig dang ma he la sogs pa/ /byol song rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs pa/ /spyan gzigs rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/

/bza' btung tshogs kyi mchod chen rnams/ /gnod sbyin= /gsol zhig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdza ོ da/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa yi//'dodapa sgrubs la bar chad sol/ /e he rma ru tse pū dza la khā hi/ zhes mchod nas skong bshags bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ bdag ni rig 'dzin sgrub pa po/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor thugs dam can/ /dam la gnas shing lha la phreng*/ khyod ni srung ma thugs dam can/ /bsgrub phyir bskul phyir gshegs su+u gsol/ /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas gnas 'dir byon/ /bos so gnod sbyin snyan ma sra/ /g.yab bo gnod sbyin spyan ma rtul/ /brten no gter bdag rgyang ma ring*/ /bsgrub bo chos skyong bong ma g.yel/ /bskul lo gnod sbyin phrag ma dog /rbad do gza' bdud mthu ma chung*/ /do nub dam bskang gnas 'dir byon/ /do nub chad dang khrims la byon /do nub mna' dang tho la byon/ /do nub grogs bya gzhung ma ngan/ /mdza' bor byas so khrel ma shor/ /mna' tho bcad do mna' ma za/ / jo bor byas so dbang ma che/ /bran ltar bskul lo rgyud ma zhan/ /dam tshig gnyan la mi sems kyang*/ /dang po'i chad la 'di min nam/ /dam tshig btsal bar ma chad dam/ /bstan pa srung bar ma byas sam/ /dam las ma g.yel da tshur byon/ /bcol pa'i las 'di ma byas na/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bka' yang bslus/ /rnal 'byor bdag kyang yi re chad/ /dang po'i chad pa'i mna' zos na/ /dam tshig gnyan po'i chad pa 'ong*/ /bka' yi dmod pas bsdig par mchis/ /de bas dam la ma 'da' zhig /thugs dam gnyan po da bskang ngo*/ /bdag kyang dam la 'da' re kan/ khyed kyang dam la ma 'da' zhig / gnyis ka dam las mi 'da' 'tshal/ /kyai= nyon cig gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la mi bden med/ /mna' dang khrims la mi brten med/ /zas dang skom la mi chags med/ /do nub khyed kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /do nub nyams chag ma lus gso/ /do nub zhig ral ma lus

gso/ /do nub lha la bshags pa bgyid/ /do nub lha la sems 'khon sbyang*/ /do nub mnyes pa'i gsol zas 'bul/ /do nub mdza' bo gzhung cig byed/ /do nub byams la lan cig sbyin/ /do nub phyi ma'i zhu skyems 'bul/ / bskang ngo khyod kyi thugs dam bskang*/ /brten pa'i dam rdzas yin pa'i phyir/ / bya rgod g.yab dar thugs dam bskang*/ /dam tshig gnyan po bsre ba'i phyir/ / bdud rtsi sman gyis= ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir/ /bza' btung sna tshogs= dgyes pa'i dam rdzas yin= khyi dmar snying gis= /rak+ta skom du btung ba'i phyir/ /dmar chen ar+ghas thugs dam bskang*/ /tshil chen dri yi bsnom pa'i phyir/ /gsur chen dud pas= rtag tu mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /brda bstod rten gtor= /gtan du phrin las bcol ba'i phyir/ /rgyun gyi gtor mas thugs= /rtag tu phrin las mdzad pa'i phyir/ /tshogs kyi mchod pas= /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i= mthun pa'i rdzas kyis= / dmag dpung ru mtshon 'gyed pa'i= /sbrul pa 'bum gyi thugs= /bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang*/ /do nub lha la mthol bshags so/ /tshor bar bdag gis ma nyams kyang*/ /ma tshor thugs dang 'gal srid kun/ / mthol lo bshags so thugs dam bskang*/ /bskang bar gyur cig lha yi tshogs/ / sgrub la bar chad gyur pa dang*/ /dam rdzas ma tshang lha la gsol/ / bsnyen sgrub g.yel dang tshogs gtor zhan/ /dam rdzas mthong dang gsang tshig smras/ / nyams chag gyur pa ci mchis pa/ /do nub bskang zhing bshags par bgyi/ / thugs dam bskangs nas dngos grub stsol/ /dam tshig nyams pa thams cad bshags/ /bar chad rkyen rnams bsrung du gsol//bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /nad gdon mi mthun rkyen rnams zlog /tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ /phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod/ / bsam pa thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ /re ba thams cad bskang du gsol/ /zhes brjod nas/ /mnga' gsol ba/

hoḥ sgrol ging chen po shan pa dmar nag /zhal gcig phyag bzhi khyung dmar bcibs pa/ /g.yas gnyis ral gri gri gug 'phyar ba/ /g.yon gnyis snying zhags bhan+bha 'dzin pa= zhing lpags rlon pa'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ /stag sham sku'i snam phyed dkris pa/ / thal chen zhag gi thig les brgyan pa/ /bka' blon lha srin sde brgyad bcas pa/ /sha za stong gi 'khor dang bcas pa la gsol lo/ /'bul lo/ /mchod do/ /dgyes pa zhal ston cig / dpal gyi mdangs skyed cig /bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /sgrub pa'i rtags phyungs shig /bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs par mdzod cig /ces brjod do/ /bsgrubs nas bstod bskul bya ba ni/ e he rma ru tse bh+yoḥ gling bzhi srid pa'i pho brang nas/ / phung byed dmar nag sku bskyod la/ / gnod sbyin chen po 'khor dang bcas/ / 'jigs pa'i gzugs can cir yang sprul/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i chibs la zhon/ /rbad pa tsam gyis dgra bo sgrol/ /bsam pa tsam gyis skye 'gro 'ching*/ /dmigs pa tsam gyis dgra bo sgrol/ /dam nyams srog rtsa rmang nas 'byin/ /dam nyams snying khrag thang la 'bo/ /longs spyod sha dang khrag la byed/ /rta ro mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs/ /mi lpags rta lpags yol ba bres//thod mkhar rin chen 'bar bas brgyan/ /gnod sbyin 'khor bcas sku bskyod cing*/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di gsol la/ /dam nyams dgra bo myur du sgrol la shog /sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas ma 'da' bar/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las myur du sgrubs/ /bdag la sdang sems ldan pa'i dgra bo 'dis/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa gnyan po bshig /lha srin sde brgyad gnod sbyin khyed dang bsdos/ /mthu dang nus pa rdzu 'phrul med ces zer/ /dam nyams dgra bo gnas nas ma bsgral na/ /gnod sbyin khyod kyis mthu rtsal rdzun du che/ /pad+ma'i bka' bcag dam tshig chad pa 'ong*/ /sdang ba'i dgra 'dis khyod la phod btsugs shing*/

/khyod kyi srog dang pho brang gnas khang dang*/ /mthu dang nus pa rdzu 'phrul 'phrog go zer/ /gnod sbyin khyod la mthu stobs yod dam med/ /yod na dus babs da lta dgra bo sgrol/ /med na rnal 'byor bdag gi yi yang chad/ /gsol mchod yun du bsgrubs pa don re chung*/ /blo gtad sgrub pa byas pa khyod kyis bslus/ /dus la bab bo phung byed las mkhan rnams/ /nam gyi gung smad dam nyams dgra bo 'di'i/ /gla 'khyams da lta nyid du khrid la shog /phung byed dmar nag thugs dam dus la babs/ khrag skyugs glo bur nad kyis sod la shog /rak+ta dmar gyi bdud rtsi 'di gsol la/ /dam nyams dgra bo da lta sgrol la shog /ba liṃ rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs da lta sgrol la shog /phung byed dmar nag thugs dam dus la babs/ /lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpon dgra la byos/ /dam nyams sha khrag tsit+ta dmar la khā hi/ /zhes bskul thal mo rdeb/ /rak+ta sbran/ shin tu do gal che na de'i gsham du rbad bskul bya ba ni/ bh+yo ཿ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ / he chen dha na'i dur khrod du/ /bsad khrag rba klong dkyil 'khor na/ /gnod sbyin yak+sha 'bar byed dang*/ /srin mo dmar sham gnyis kyi bu/ /phung byed dmar nag mthu rtsal can/ /yang le shod kyi brag phug tu/ /slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru/ /mdongs gsol srog gi snying po phul/ /lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /khas blangs dam can da rgyug cig /sngags 'chang rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bdag /byang chub bsgrub tu ma ster ro/ /bdag la sdang byed dgra bo 'dis/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku la bsdos/ /mched lcam rnams la gnod cing

'tshe/ /rdo rje rgyal po rmang du phab/ / chos 'khor 'jig cing rgyal khams phung*/ /dben gnas gnyan po 'di yis bshig /chos srung sgom sgrub bar chad byas/ /sdig can chos la dmod pa 'di'i/ /snying rtsa phyungs la srog rtsa chod/ /ltas ngan phung khrol sna tshogs thongs/ /myur du thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bh+yo ཿ gnod sbyin chen po'i dus la babs/ /dam nyams gdug pa'i dgra bo la/ /cho 'phrul btang ba'i dus la babs/ /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo la/ /'od dang me stag rdo char phob/ /wa brgyal spre'u smyo 'bog thongs/ /me 'od gcer pu gri thogs thongs/ / 'tshubs nag me dpung rlung dmar thongs/ /dngangs skrag glo snying 'brub tu chug /srin bya 'ug pa 'khun du chug /lce spyang dur bya 'khrul du chug /skra 'then thog rdungs ming nas bos/ /thog rdib rta phung sgo khyi sod/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ bh+yo= he chen khrag gi dur khrod nas/ /gnod sbyin chen po sku bskyod cig /bshan pa dmar po dam la byon/ /chigs su zangs kyi khyung dmar bcibs/ /khyung dmar gnam lcags mchu sder can/ /dgra bo'i nang khrol phyung la shog /dgra bo'i sha zo khrag la 'thung*/ /'dab gshog zangs dkar spu gri yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i mgo lus gtubs/ /gnod sbyin chen po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ / dmar nag khrag gi ral pa can/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi khros pa'i sku/ / g.yas kyi dang po ral gri yis/ /sdang byed dgra bo srog rtsa chod/ /'og ma gri gug dgra snying 'byin/ /g.yon pas snying dang rgyu zhags bsnams/ /dgra mchin dgra snying zhal du gsol/ /'og ma thod khrag bhan+dha 'dzin/ /dgra bo'i snying khrag zhal du gsol/ /zhing lpags rlon pa stod la gsol/ /stag sham sku yi snam phyed dkris/ /thal chen khrag gi thig les brgyan/ /sku las me 'bar mtshon cha yis/ /dam nyams gdug pa'i dgra la 'debs/ /ljags ni glog ltar 'khyugs pa yis/ /dgra yi snying chu hub kyis 'debs/

/mche ba zung gsum gtsigs pa yis/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha la gsol/ /zhal gdangs dug rlangs nga ro yis/ /dam nyams dgra la nad yams phob/ khro gnyer ral pa spungs pa yis/ /dam nyams dgra la gzer nad phob/ /gnod sbyin srin po ma rungs pa/ /sha za khrag 'thung stong gis bskor/ /lha srin sde brgyad dmag dpung bcas/ /zhub chen bso sgra di ri ri/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs sha ra ra/ khrag gi bu yug si li li/ /dur khrod lce spyang 'du ru ru/ /dur bya khwa ta khro lo lo/ /bdud bya kha cang tse re re/ /dur khrod 'dre mo mang po yis/ /ngu 'bod g.yab mo lings se ling*/ /me long mtshon cha si li li/ /dug nad rlangs pa bun ne ne/ /gcer bu mtshon thogs ye re re/ /'tshubs ma 'brug sgra di ri ri/ /gnam lcags thog 'bebs lams se lam/ / dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ /gnod sbyin shan pa 'khor bcas rnams/ /bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /rbad pa tshe na mthu ma chung*/ /brten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring*/ /bsgrub pa'i tshe na sgrub ma dka'/ /g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma brtul/ /gsod pa'i tshe na ngang ma ring*//rbad kyang phrin las mi byed na/ /dam tshig nyams par mi 'gyur ram/ /da rung dgra bo mi gsod na/ / gnod sbyin khyod la ci byung kye/ /da lta nyid du sod la shog /sha zo khrag 'thung snying rtsa phyungs/ /bla srog chod la dus mtha' bstung*/ /glo bur khrag skyugs gri ru sod/ /gnod sbyin chen po drag rtsal can/ /mthu rtsal shin tu che yo skad/ /do nub nub gcig tshun chod la/ / dam nyams dgra bo ma bsad na/ khyod kyi mthu rtsal mi bden gyi/ /da lta nyid du sod la shog /sha zo khrag 'thung snying rtsa phyungs/ /bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog /gnod sbyin chen po da rgyug cig /las mkhan chen po= phung byed dmar nag= shan pa dmar nag= gnod sbyin dmag tshogs= lha srin sde brgyad= dur khrod sha za= /dgra bo 'khor bcas sod la shog /dur khrod 'dre mo da rgyug cig
